_readme: Structural taxonomy of the documentation site. Content lives elsewhere:
systems/<slug>.md   — curated prose for that system (optional)
systems/<slug>.json — command membership, examples, edge cases, known issues
Command membership comes from systems/<slug>.json first, then from permissionPrefixes.
upstreamDoc names a file in docs/Wiki/ that is embedded verbatim, so upstream syncs of
that directory never conflict with anything written here.

systems.title: Economy
systems.lede: Balances, transfers, /baltop, chest and NPC shops, Vault API.

systems.title: Teleportation
systems.lede: Homes, warps, /tpa, /back, random teleport and the spawn point.

systems.title: Moderation
systems.lede: Bans, temporary bans, IP bans, kicks, mutes, jail, vanish and freeze.

systems.title: Chat and messages
systems.lede: Formatting, private messages, mail, mentions, gradients and animations.

systems.title: Chat channels
systems.lede: Channel setup, channel permissions and relaying to Discord.

systems.title: Discord integration
systems.lede: SDLink / Mc2Discord / DCIntegration bridges, webhooks without a bridge mod, role sync into permission groups.

systems.title: Auction house
systems.lede: Players list items from their hand, buy through a GUI and collect unsold items from /ah expired.

systems.title: Kits
systems.lede: Item sets, cooldowns, usage limits and giving kits to other players.

systems.title: Items
systems.lede: Repair, enchanting, powertool, renaming, stack condensing and books.

systems.title: Utility commands
systems.lede: Personal time and weather, effects, mob spawning, /fly, /god, /heal and other everyday tools.

systems.title: AFK
systems.lede: Automatic AFK, idle kick, tab list indicator.

systems.title: Holograms
systems.lede: Floating animated text, rotation, bobbing, click-to-trade and placeholders.

systems.title: Scoreboard
systems.lede: A config-driven sidebar: display conditions, line animation, per-group and per-player overrides.

systems.title: Leaderboards
systems.lede: Ranking boards from vanilla statistics, the economy and custom scores, with a GUI and holograms.

systems.title: Tab list
systems.lede: Animated header and footer, hex colours, gradients, sorting by group.

systems.title: Crates
systems.lede: Crates with weighted rewards, keys, physical blocks and an opening animation.

systems.title: Votifier
systems.lede: Receives votes from server lists over the V1 (RSA) and V2 (NuVotifier) protocols.

systems.title: Permission system
systems.lede: Groups, prefixes, wildcards, LuckPerms/FTB. As shipped: explicit grants; a registry default is not a grant.

systems.title: Web dashboard
systems.lede: Installation, login, account linking via Discord and the external hosting mode.

systems.title: Dashboard connectivity
systems.lede: Internal and external modes, webDashboard.mode and troubleshooting connection problems.

systems.title: Localization
systems.lede: Choosing the server language, your own translations and overriding individual strings.

systems.title: Storage
systems.lede: Pluggable JSON, YAML, SQLite and MySQL backends for all mod data.

systems.title: Split configs
systems.lede: Splitting config.json into per-system files, validation, repair and migration.

systems.title: Logging
systems.lede: Per-subsystem normal/debug switches, categories and logs/debug.log.

systems.title: API and placeholders
systems.lede: PlaceholderAPI, Vault, LeaderboardAPI and REST endpoints for third-party mods.
